GS-5745 inhibits MMP9 by two mechanisms: 1) inhibiting the catalytic activity of MMP9 by sterically interfering with proteolysis of substrates 2) inhibiting the processing of MMP9 to an active form by sterically preventing accessibility of activating proteases. This results in an inhibition of extracellular matrix protein degradation and, potentially, the inhibition of angiogenesis, tumor growth, invasion, and metastasis.
